<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<base href="./">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0a0a">
<meta name="description" content="DevAuth Blox Fruits Adventure - browser game">
<title>DevAuth // Blox Fruits Adventure</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css" />
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap');

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  html, body {
    height: 100%;
    background: #0a0a0a;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    color: #e8e8e8;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  body {
    min-height: 100vh;
    padding: 24px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04), transparent 40%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04), transparent 40%),
      #0a0a0a;
  }

  .window {
    width: 760px;
    max-width: 100%;
    background: #111113;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* Menu bar */
  .menubar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    background: #1a1a1d;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: #6b6b70;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #232326;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .menubar span:hover { color: #d4d4d8; }

  /* Title bar */
  .titlebar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    background: #1a1a1d;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
  }
  .dot { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3a3a3e; }
  .titlebar-label {
    margin-left: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #6b6b70;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  /* Tabs */
  .tabs {
    display: flex;
    background: #0d0d0f;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
  }
  .tab {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 12px 0;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: #6b6b70;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .tab .dotfile { color: #4a4a4e; }
  .tab.active {
    color: #ffffff;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #ffffff;
    background: #111113;
  }
  .tab:not(.active):hover { color: #b8b8bc; background: #131315; }

  /* Body / editor area */
  .editor {
    padding: 26px 28px 28px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .linecol {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
    width: 34px;
    padding-top: 26px;
    color: #333338;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 2.6;
    text-align: right;
    padding-right: 10px;
    border-right: 1px solid #1e1e21;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .code {
    padding-left: 44px;
  }
  .kw { color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; }
  .fn { color: #d4d4d8; }
  .comment { color: #52525b; font-style: italic; }
  .str { color: #9a9aa0; }

  .field-line { margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .field-label {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  input {
    width: 100%;
    background: #0a0a0b;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 13.5px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
  }
  input::placeholder { color: #45454a; }
  input:focus {
    border-color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #ffffff, 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  }

  .caret {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 7px; height: 15px;
    background: #ffffff;
    margin-left: 2px;
    vertical-align: middle;
    animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

  .btn {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 6px;
    padding: 11px 0;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #0a0a0a;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 13.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .btn:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(255,255,255,0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

  .btn-ghost {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 10px;
    padding: 10px 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: #8a8a8f;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #ffffff; color: #ffffff; }

  .statusbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    background: #1a1a1d;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    color: #8a8a8f;
  }
  .statusbar .left, .statusbar .right { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; }
  .statusbar span.ok { color: #d4d4d8; }
  .dot-live {
    width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: #ffffff;
    display: inline-block;
    margin-right: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px #ffffff;
    animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }

  .msg {
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-top: 10px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    display: none;
  }
  .msg.show { display: block; }
  .msg.error { color: #ffffff; border-color: #5a5a5e; background: #1c1c1f; }
  .msg.success { color: #0a0a0a; background: #ffffff; border-color: #ffffff; }

  .accounts-list {
    margin-top: 4px;
    max-height: 120px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: #6b6b70;
  }
  .accounts-list::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
  .accounts-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #3a3a3e; }

  .account-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 6px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1e1e21;
  }
  .account-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .account-row .name { color: #d4d4d8; }
  .del-btn {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #52525b;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .del-btn:hover { color: #ffffff; }

  .panel { display: none; }
  .panel.active { display: block; }

  .hint { color: #45454a; font-size: 11px; margin-top: 4px; }

  .loading-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(10,10,11,0.6);
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #ffffff;
    z-index: 5;
  }
  .loading-overlay.show { display: flex; }

  .body-row {
    display: flex;
    min-height: 420px;
  }

  .activity-bar {
    width: 44px;
    background: #141416;
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 0;
    gap: 18px;
  }
  .activity-icon {
    width: 20px; height: 20px;
    color: #5a5a5e;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
  }
  .activity-icon.active { color: #ffffff; }
  .activity-icon.active::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: -10px; top: 0;
    width: 2px; height: 20px;
    background: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px #ffffff;
  }
  .activity-icon:last-child { margin-top: auto; }
  .activity-bar .spacer { flex: 1; }

  .sidebar {
    width: 190px;
    background: #0d0d0f;
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    padding: 10px 0;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .sidebar-title {
    color: #8a8a8f;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    padding: 4px 16px 8px;
  }
  .sidebar-folder {
    color: #d4d4d8;
    padding: 3px 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
  }
  .sidebar-file {
    padding: 5px 12px 5px 30px;
    color: #8a8a8f;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    border-left: 2px solid transparent;
  }
  .sidebar-file:hover { background: #16161a; color: #d4d4d8; }
  .sidebar-file.active { background: #1a1a1d; color: #ffffff; border-left: 2px solid #ffffff; }
  .sidebar-file .sq { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #3a3a3e; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .sidebar-file.active .sq { background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 5px #ffffff; }

  .main-col {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .breadcrumb {
    padding: 6px 16px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #52525b;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1e1e21;
  }
  .breadcrumb .sep { margin: 0 5px; color: #333338; }
  .breadcrumb .cur { color: #b8b8bc; }

  .divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 16px 0 12px;
    color: #45454a;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .divider::before, .divider::after {
    content: '';
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: #2a2a2e;
  }

  .btn-google {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px 0;
    background: #0a0a0b;
    color: #e8e8e8;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
  }
  .btn-google:hover { border-color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

  .modal-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 50;
  }
  .modal-overlay.show { display: flex; }
  .modal-box {
    width: 320px;
    background: #111113;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }
  .modal-box h3 {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    color: #d4d4d8;
  }
  .modal-box .field-line { margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .modal-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }
  .modal-actions .btn { margin-top: 0; }
  .modal-actions .btn-ghost { margin-top: 0; }

  /* ---- Màn hình bản đồ (hiện sau khi login thành công) ---- */
  .screen {
    display: none;
  }
  .screen.active { display: block; }

  #screen-map .titlebar { justify-content: space-between; }
  .map-title-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-left: auto; }
  .map-session-tag {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #8a8a8f;
  }
  .btn-back {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
    color: #8a8a8f;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .btn-back:hover { border-color: #ffffff; color: #ffffff; }

  #leafletMap {
    width: 100%;
    height: 460px;
    background: #0d0d0f;
    filter: grayscale(0.15) contrast(1.02);
  }
  .map-footer {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #6b6b70;
    background: #1a1a1d;
    border-top: 1px solid #2a2a2e;
  }

  /* ===== CHỌN PHE + GAME VÕ HỎA ===== */
  #screen-faction, #screen-game { width: 960px; }
  .faction-wrap { padding: 28px; }
  .faction-title { font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .faction-sub { color:#8a8a8f; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:22px; }
  .faction-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:16px; }
  .faction-card {
    border:1px solid #2a2a2e; border-radius:8px; padding:20px; cursor:pointer;
    background:#0d0d0f; transition:.18s;
  }
  .faction-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:#fff; }
  .faction-card.fire { box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(255,80,0,.08); }
  .faction-card.ice { box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(70,190,255,.10); }
  .faction-card.locked { opacity:.38; cursor:not-allowed; }
  .faction-icon { font-size:42px; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .faction-name { font-size:18px; font-weight:700; }
  .faction-desc { margin-top:8px; color:#8a8a8f; font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; }

  .game-shell { position:relative; background:#080808; }
  #gameCanvas { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; background:#111; image-rendering:pixelated; }
  .game-hud {
    position:absolute; left:14px; top:14px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid #2a2a2e;
    background:rgba(10,10,10,.78); border-radius:6px; font-size:11px; line-height:1.8;
  }
  .skills-hud {
    position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:14px; transform:translateX(-50%);
    display:flex; gap:8px;
  }
  .skill-box {
    min-width:170px; padding:9px 10px; border:1px solid #333; background:rgba(10,10,10,.84);
    border-radius:6px; font-size:10px;
  }
  .skill-box strong { color:#fff; font-size:11px; }
  .skill-box.locked { opacity:.42; }
  .skill-key {
    display:inline-flex; width:22px; height:22px; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    border:1px solid #777; border-radius:4px; margin-right:6px; font-weight:700;
  }
  .top-gamebar { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:9px 13px; background:#1a1a1d; }
  .small-btn { background:transparent; color:#aaa; border:1px solid #333; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; }
  .small-btn:hover { color:#fff; border-color:#fff; }
  .game-msg {
    position:absolute; top:16px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.8); border:1px solid #444; border-radius:5px;
    padding:8px 12px; font-size:11px; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:.2s;
  }
  .game-msg.show { opacity:1; }


  /* ===== DEVICE / MOBILE / STATS / LEVEL ===== */
  #screen-device { width: 760px; }
  .device-wrap { padding: 28px; }
  .device-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px; margin-top:18px; }
  .device-card {
    background:#0d0d0f; border:1px solid #2a2a2e; border-radius:8px; padding:24px;
    cursor:pointer; text-align:center; transition:.18s;
  }
  .device-card:hover { border-color:#fff; transform:translateY(-2px); }
  .device-icon { font-size:46px; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .device-card b { display:block; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .device-card span { color:#8a8a8f; font-size:11px; }

  .level-box {
    position:absolute; right:14px; top:14px; min-width:210px;
    background:rgba(8,8,8,.82); border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;
    padding:9px 10px; font-size:11px;
  }
  .bar { height:8px; background:#1c1c1c; border:1px solid #333; margin-top:5px; overflow:hidden; }
  .bar > div { height:100%; width:0%; background:#eee; transition:.2s; }

  .skill-panel {
    position:absolute; right:12px; top:96px; width:245px;
    background:rgba(8,8,8,.86); border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .skill-panel-title {
    text-align:center; font-weight:700; padding:7px; background:#111;
    border-bottom:1px solid #333; font-size:13px;
  }
  .unlock-line { text-align:center; padding:5px; color:#ddd; font-size:11px; border-bottom:1px solid #333; }
  .skill-row {
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:48px 1fr 34px; align-items:center;
    border-bottom:1px solid #292929; min-height:48px; font-size:11px;
  }
  .skill-row:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
  .skill-use {
    height:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    border-right:1px solid #333; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; user-select:none;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  }
  .skill-use:active { background:rgba(255,100,0,.2); }
  .skill-name { padding:6px 8px; line-height:1.35; }
  .skill-name small { color:#a9a9ad; font-size:9px; }
  .skill-key-pc { text-align:center; color:#ccc; font-weight:700; }
  .skill-row.locked { opacity:.35; }

  .stats-toggle {
    position:absolute; left:14px; bottom:14px; z-index:8;
    background:#f1d53c; color:#111; border:2px solid #111; border-radius:3px;
    font-weight:700; padding:8px 18px; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 2px 0 #000;
  }
  .stats-panel {
    position:absolute; left:14px; bottom:58px; width:250px; z-index:9;
    background:#171719; border:2px solid #050505; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #777;
    display:none;
  }
  .stats-panel.open { display:block; }
  .stats-title { text-align:center; font-weight:700; background:#0d0d0f; padding:6px; }
  .stat-row {
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 70px 34px; align-items:center;
    border-top:1px solid #3b3b3b; min-height:32px; font-size:12px;
  }
  .stat-row span:first-child { padding-left:8px; font-weight:700; }
  .stat-row .stat-value { text-align:right; padding-right:7px; }
  .stat-plus {
    height:26px; margin-right:4px; background:#ffe76a; border:1px solid #111;
    color:#111; font-weight:900; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .available-points { text-align:center; padding:7px; border-top:1px solid #444; font-size:11px; }
  .stat-note {
    padding:5px 8px;
    color:#8aaeff;
    font-size:9px;
    border-top:1px solid #303030;
    border-bottom:1px solid #303030;
    line-height:1.4;
  }

  .mobile-controls { display:none; }
  .joystick {
    position:absolute; left:22px; bottom:22px; width:118px; height:118px;
    border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    touch-action:none; z-index:12;
  }
  .joystick-knob {
    position:absolute; left:34px; top:34px; width:48px; height:48px;
    border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,.35); border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  }
  .mobile-m1 {
    position:absolute; right:28px; bottom:28px; width:74px; height:74px;
    border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,90,0,.55); border:2px solid #ff9a4a;
    color:white; font-weight:800; z-index:12; touch-action:none;
  }

  body.mobile-mode { padding:0; align-items:stretch; }
  body.mobile-mode .window { width:100vw !important; max-width:none; border-radius:0; min-height:100vh; }
  body.mobile-mode #screen-game { height:100vh; }
  body.mobile-mode .top-gamebar { min-height:44px; }
  body.mobile-mode .game-shell { height:calc(100vh - 44px); overflow:hidden; }
  body.mobile-mode #gameCanvas { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }
  body.mobile-mode .mobile-controls { display:block; }
  body.mobile-mode .game-hud { font-size:9px; max-width:170px; }
  body.mobile-mode .level-box { right:8px; top:8px; min-width:160px; font-size:9px; }
  body.mobile-mode .skill-panel {
    right:7px; top:82px; width:205px; transform:scale(.88); transform-origin:top right;
  }
  body.mobile-mode .skill-key-pc { display:none; }
  body.mobile-mode .skill-row { grid-template-columns:48px 1fr; }
  body.mobile-mode .stats-toggle { left:150px; bottom:18px; padding:7px 13px; }
  body.mobile-mode .stats-panel { left:150px; bottom:56px; width:220px; }
  body.mobile-mode .top-gamebar .small-btn { font-size:9px; padding:5px 7px; }

  @media(max-width:700px) {
    .device-grid,.faction-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .body-row .sidebar,.activity-bar { display:none; }
    .window { width:100%; }
  }


  .currency-box {
    position:absolute; right:14px; top:82px; min-width:210px;
    background:rgba(8,8,8,.82); border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;
    padding:8px 10px; font-size:11px;
  }
  .hidden-boss-modal {
    position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:30; display:none;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);
  }
  .hidden-boss-modal.show { display:flex; }
  .hidden-boss-box {
    width:340px; max-width:90%;
    background:#111113; border:1px solid #555; border-radius:8px;
    padding:20px; text-align:center;
    box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(255,70,0,.12);
  }
  .hidden-boss-box h3 { margin-bottom:10px; font-size:16px; }
  .hidden-boss-box p { font-size:11px; color:#aaa; line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .hidden-boss-actions { display:flex; gap:10px; }
  .hidden-boss-actions button {
    flex:1; padding:9px; border-radius:5px; cursor:pointer;
    font-family:inherit; border:1px solid #444;
  }
  .hidden-boss-actions .accept { background:#ff6a00; color:#fff; }
  .hidden-boss-actions .decline { background:#111; color:#aaa; }
  .safe-zone-label {
    position:absolute; left:50%; top:14px; transform:translateX(-50%);
    padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; font-size:10px;
    background:rgba(50,180,90,.18); border:1px solid rgba(80,220,120,.45);
    color:#9dffb2; display:none;
  }
  .safe-zone-label.show { display:block; }
  body.mobile-mode .currency-box { right:8px; top:66px; min-width:160px; font-size:9px; }
  body.mobile-mode .skill-panel { top:118px; }

  .sword-shop-modal { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:31; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,.72); }
  .sword-shop-modal.show { display:flex; }
  .sword-shop-box { width:430px; max-width:92%; background:#101419; border:1px solid #6abfff; border-radius:9px; padding:18px; box-shadow:0 0 36px rgba(70,180,255,.18); }
  .sword-shop-title { font-size:18px; font-weight:800; color:#bcecff; margin-bottom:4px; }
  .sword-shop-sub { color:#91a8b6; font-size:11px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .sword-list { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px; }
  .sword-item { border:1px solid #33434d; background:#0b0f13; border-radius:7px; padding:10px; text-align:center; }
  .sword-img-placeholder { height:125px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px dashed #46606f; color:#6f8b9b; margin-bottom:8px; font-size:10px; overflow:hidden; background:#fff; }
  .sword-img-placeholder img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; image-rendering:pixelated; }
  .seller-avatar { width:54px; height:54px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover; border:2px solid #9ee7ff; box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(100,210,255,.45); }
  .seller-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-bottom:12px; }
  .weapon-state { font-size:10px; color:#a9dfff; margin-top:4px; }
  .sword-item button { width:100%; margin-top:8px; padding:7px; border:1px solid #4e7185; background:#13232d; color:#bcecff; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
  .shop-close { width:100%; margin-top:12px; padding:8px; background:#111; color:#aaa; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:5px; cursor:pointer; }


  .item-toggle { position:absolute; left:108px; bottom:14px; z-index:8; background:#64d96b; color:#111; border:2px solid #111; border-radius:3px; font-weight:700; padding:8px 18px; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 2px 0 #000; }
  .item-panel { position:absolute; left:108px; bottom:58px; width:260px; z-index:9; background:#171719; border:2px solid #050505; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #777; display:none; }
  .item-panel.open { display:block; }
  .item-title { text-align:center; font-weight:700; background:#0d0d0f; padding:7px; }
  .item-row { padding:9px; border-top:1px solid #383838; font-size:11px; line-height:1.5; }
  .island-box { position:absolute; right:14px; top:132px; min-width:210px; background:rgba(8,8,8,.82); border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px; font-size:11px; }
  .island-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:6px}.island-actions button,.redeem-key-btn{flex:1;padding:5px 6px;background:#151515;color:#ddd;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:4px;font:9px inherit;cursor:pointer}.island-actions button:hover,.redeem-key-btn:hover{border-color:#fff;color:#fff}.redeem-key-btn{width:100%;margin-top:6px}
  body.mobile-mode .item-toggle { left:230px; bottom:18px; padding:7px 12px; }
  body.mobile-mode .item-panel { left:130px; bottom:56px; width:235px; }
  body.mobile-mode .island-box { right:8px; top:98px; min-width:160px; font-size:9px; }


  .npc-modal { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:34; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,.74); }
  .npc-modal.show { display:flex; }
  .npc-modal-box { width:390px; max-width:92%; background:#101216; border:1px solid #65707c; border-radius:9px; padding:18px; box-shadow:0 0 35px rgba(120,180,255,.14); }
  .npc-modal-title { font-size:18px; font-weight:800; margin-bottom:5px; }
  .npc-modal-sub { color:#9ba5af; font-size:11px; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:13px; }
  .npc-choice-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:9px; }
  .npc-choice { padding:12px 8px; background:#15191e; color:#e8e8e8; border:1px solid #3d4852; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; font-size:11px; }
  .npc-choice:hover { border-color:#fff; }
  .npc-choice.locked { opacity:.38; cursor:not-allowed; }
  .npc-choice small { display:block; color:#8c98a3; margin-top:4px; }
  .npc-modal-close { width:100%; margin-top:10px; padding:8px; background:#0d0d0f; color:#aaa; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:5px; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
  .island-actions { display:none !important; }

</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ================= MÀN HÌNH ĐĂNG NHẬP / ĐĂNG KÝ ================= -->
<div class="window screen active" id="screen-auth">
  <div class="menubar">
    <span>File</span><span>Edit</span><span>Selection</span><span>View</span><span>Go</span><span>Run</span><span>Terminal</span><span>Help</span>
  </div>
  <div class="titlebar">
    <div class="dot" style="background:#4a4a4e"></div>
    <div class="dot" style="background:#4a4a4e"></div>
    <div class="dot" style="background:#4a4a4e"></div>
    <span class="titlebar-label">devauth — visual studio session</span>
  </div>

  <div class="body-row">
    <div class="activity-bar">
      <svg class="activity-icon active" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 4h16v16H4z"/><path d="M4 9h16M9 9v11"/></svg>
      <svg class="activity-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg>
      <svg class="activity-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2.2"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="2.2"/><circle cx="18" cy="12" r="2.2"/><path d="M6 8.2V15.8M8 6.5h6a3 3 0 0 1 3 3v.5"/></svg>
      <svg class="activity-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M9 9h6v6H9z"/></svg>
      <svg class="activity-icon spacer" style="visibility:hidden;" viewBox="0 0 24 24"></svg>
      <svg class="activity-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3.2"/><path d="M5 20c1.5-3.5 4.5-5 7-5s5.5 1.5 7 5"/></svg>
      <svg class="activity-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.8"/><path d="M12 3v2.4M12 18.6V21M21 12h-2.4M5.4 12H3M18 6l-1.6 1.6M7.6 16.4L6 18M18 18l-1.6-1.6M7.6 7.6L6 6"/></svg>
    </div>

    <div class="sidebar">
      <div class="sidebar-title">devauth</div>
      <div class="sidebar-folder">▾ src</div>
      <div class="sidebar-file active" data-tab="login"><span class="sq"></span>login.js</div>
      <div class="sidebar-file" data-tab="register"><span class="sq"></span>register.js</div>
      <div class="sidebar-file" style="opacity:0.4; cursor:default;"><span class="sq"></span>README.md</div>
    </div>

    <div class="main-col">
      <div class="breadcrumb">devauth <span class="sep">›</span> src <span class="sep">›</span> <span class="cur" id="breadcrumbFile">login.js</span></div>

      <div class="tabs">
        <div class="tab active" data-tab="login"><span class="dotfile">●</span> login.js</div>
        <div class="tab" data-tab="register"><span class="dotfile">●</span> register.js</div>
      </div>

      <div style="position:relative; flex:1;">
        <div class="loading-overlay" id="loadingOverlay">syncing storage<span class="caret"></span></div>

        <!-- LOGIN PANEL -->
        <div class="panel active" id="panel-login">
          <div class="editor">
            <div class="linecol">1<br>2<br>3<br>4<br>5<br>6</div>
            <div class="code">
              <div class="comment">// authenticate.session()</div>
              <br>

              <div class="field-line">
                <div class="field-label"><span class="kw">const</span> <span class="fn">username</span> =</div>
                <input type="text" id="loginUser" placeholder="tên_đăng_nhập" autocomplete="off">
              </div>

              <div class="field-line">
                <div class="field-label"><span class="kw">const</span> <span class="fn">password</span> =</div>
                <input type="password" id="loginPass" placeholder="••••••••">
              </div>

              <button class="btn" id="btnLogin">run login() <span class="caret"></span></button>
              <div class="msg" id="loginMsg"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- REGISTER PANEL -->
        <div class="panel" id="panel-register">
          <div class="editor">
            <div class="linecol">1<br>2<br>3<br>4<br>5<br>6<br>7<br>8</div>
            <div class="code">
              <div class="comment">// createAccount(new User())</div>
              <br>

              <div class="field-line">
                <div class="field-label"><span class="kw">let</span> <span class="fn">username</span> =</div>
                <input type="text" id="regUser" placeholder="tên_đăng_nhập" autocomplete="off">
              </div>

              <div class="field-line">
                <div class="field-label"><span class="kw">let</span> <span class="fn">password</span> =</div>
                <input type="password" id="regPass" placeholder="••••••••">
              </div>

              <div class="field-line">
                <div class="field-label"><span class="kw">let</span> <span class="fn">confirm</span> =</div>
                <input type="password" id="regPass2" placeholder="••••••••">
              </div>

              <button class="btn" id="btnRegister">run createAccount() <span class="caret"></span></button>
              <div class="msg" id="regMsg"></div>

              <div class="hint" style="margin-top:14px;">// tài khoản đã lưu (<span id="acctCount">0</span>)</div>
              <div class="accounts-list" id="acctList"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="statusbar">
    <span><span class="dot-live"></span>storage: <span class="ok" id="storageStatus">localStorage...</span></span>
    <span id="sessionStatus">no session</span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ================= MÀN HÌNH BẢN ĐỒ (sau khi login) ================= -->
<div class="window screen" id="screen-map">
  <div class="titlebar">
    <div class="dot" style="background:#4a4a4e"></div>
    <div class="dot" style="background:#4a4a4e"></div>
    <div class="dot" style="background:#4a4a4e"></div>
    <span class="titlebar-label">devauth — map.view()</span>
    <div class="map-title-actions">
      <span class="map-session-tag" id="mapSessionTag">session: —</span>
      <button class="btn-back" id="btnBackToAuth">← đăng xuất</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="breadcrumb">devauth <span class="sep">›</span> views <span class="sep">›</span> <span class="cur">map.js</span></div>

  <div id="leafletMap"></div>

  <div class="map-footer">
    // placeholder bản đồ — gửi bản đồ của bạn để mình gắn thay vào đây
  </div>
</div>



<!-- ================= CHỌN THIẾT BỊ ================= -->
<div class="window screen" id="screen-device">
  <div class="titlebar">
    <div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div>
    <span class="titlebar-label">devauth — choose_device()</span>
    <button class="btn-back" id="logoutDevice">đăng xuất</button>
  </div>
  <div class="device-wrap">
    <div class="faction-title">CHỌN THIẾT BỊ</div>
    <div class="faction-sub">Chọn cách điều khiển trước khi chọn phe.</div>
    <div class="device-grid">
      <div class="device-card" id="choosePC">
        <div class="device-icon">🖥️</div><b>PC</b>
        <span>WASD, chuột trái, phím Z X C</span>
      </div>
      <div class="device-card" id="chooseMobile">
        <div class="device-icon">📱</div><b>MOBILE</b>
        <span>Con lăn di chuyển, nút M1 và nút skill cảm ứng</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ================= MÀN HÌNH CHỌN PHE ================= -->
<div class="window screen" id="screen-faction">
  <div class="titlebar">
    <div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div>
    <span class="titlebar-label">devauth — choose_faction()</span>
    <button class="btn-back" id="logoutFaction">đăng xuất</button>
  </div>
  <div class="faction-wrap">
    <div class="faction-title">CHỌN PHE</div>
    <div class="faction-sub">Tài khoản: <span id="factionUser">—</span> · lựa chọn sẽ được lưu tự động</div>
    <div class="faction-grid">
      <div class="faction-card fire" id="chooseFire">
        <div class="faction-icon">🔥</div>
        <div class="faction-name">PHE HỎA</div>
        <div class="faction-desc">
          Võ Hỏa với 3 kỹ năng:<br>
          Z — Hỏa Tứ Quyền<br>
          X — Hỏa Hóa Tiên Cung<br>
          C — Cửu Ngũ Cung Loạn Hỏa
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="faction-card ice" id="chooseIce">
        <div class="faction-icon">❄️</div>
        <div class="faction-name">PHE BĂNG</div>
        <div class="faction-desc">
          Băng Quyền với 3 kỹ năng:<br>
          Z — Băng Quyền Cung<br>
          X — Băng Sát Phạt<br>
          C — Băng La Sát
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="faction-card" id="chooseWind" style="box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(120,255,180,.10);">
        <div class="faction-icon">🌪️</div>
        <div class="faction-name">PHE PHONG</div>
        <div class="faction-desc">
          Phong Quyền với 3 kỹ năng:<br>
          Z — Phong Cước Truy Kích<br>
          X — Lốc Phong Tỏa Mục Tiêu<br>
          C — Thiên Phong Chấn Bạo
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="faction-card locked" id="chooseLightning" style="box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(180,130,255,.10);">
        <div class="faction-icon">⚡</div>
        <div class="faction-name">PHE LÔI</div>
        <div class="faction-desc">Chưa cập nhật.<br>Hiện tại không thể chọn phe này.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ================= MÀN HÌNH GAME ================= -->
<div class="window screen" id="screen-game">
  <div class="top-gamebar">
    <span>game.js · phe <b id="gameFaction">HỎA</b></span>
    <div>
      <button class="small-btn" id="fullscreenBtn">phóng to [F]</button>
      <button class="small-btn" id="toggleWeapon">đổi võ/kiếm [T]</button>
      <button class="small-btn" id="logoutGame">đăng xuất</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="game-shell">
    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="920" height="540"></canvas>
    <div class="game-hud">
      <div>Người chơi: <span id="hudUser">—</span></div>
      <div>NPC: <span id="hudNpc">0</span> · Boss: <span id="hudBoss">0</span></div>
      <div>Lv: <span id="hudLevel">1</span> · EXP: <span id="hudExp">0</span>/<span id="hudExpNeed">100</span></div>
      <div>HP: <span id="hudHp">100</span></div>
      <div>Hồi máu: <span id="hudRegen">5</span> HP/s</div>
      <div id="controlHint">Di chuyển: WASD / mũi tên</div><div id="m1Hint">M1: Chuột trái</div>
    </div>
    <div class="level-box">
      <div>LEVEL <span id="levelText">1</span></div>
      <div class="bar"><div id="expBar"></div></div>
      <div style="margin-top:4px;">EXP <span id="expText">0 / 100</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="currency-box">
      <div>Tiền: <span id="moneyText">0</span></div>
      <div>Boss Key: <span id="keyText">0</span></div>
      <button class="redeem-key-btn" id="redeemKeyBtn">Redeem Key</button>
    </div>
    <div class="island-box">Đảo: <span id="islandText">Đảo Khởi Đầu</span><br><small id="islandHint">Đảo Rừng mở ở level 25</small><div class="island-actions"><button id="goIsland1">Đảo 1</button><button id="goIsland2">Đảo 2</button></div></div>

    <div class="skill-panel">
      <div class="skill-panel-title" id="fightingStyleTitle">DRAGON TALON</div>
      <div class="unlock-line">Unlock (<span id="unlockCount">0</span>/3)</div>
      <div class="skill-row" id="skillZ">
        <div class="skill-use" data-skill="z">Use</div>
        <div class="skill-name" id="skillNameZ">Hỏa Tứ Quyền<br><small>Nhiệm vụ: hạ 10 NPC</small></div>
        <div class="skill-key-pc">[Z]</div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-row" id="skillX">
        <div class="skill-use" data-skill="x">Use</div>
        <div class="skill-name" id="skillNameX">Hỏa Hóa Tiên Cung<br><small>Nhiệm vụ: hạ 20 NPC</small></div>
        <div class="skill-key-pc">[X]</div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-row" id="skillC">
        <div class="skill-use" data-skill="c">Use</div>
        <div class="skill-name" id="skillNameC">Cửu Ngũ Cung Loạn Hỏa<br><small>Nhiệm vụ: hạ 30 NPC + 1 Boss</small></div>
        <div class="skill-key-pc">[C]</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <button class="stats-toggle" id="statsToggle">Stats</button>
    <div class="stats-panel" id="statsPanel">
      <div class="stats-title">STATS</div>
      <div class="stat-row"><span style="color:#ff7272">Melee</span><span class="stat-value" id="statMelee">0</span><button class="stat-plus" data-stat="melee">+</button></div>
      <div class="stat-row"><span style="color:#75a7ff">Defense</span><span class="stat-value" id="statDefense">0</span><button class="stat-plus" data-stat="defense">+</button></div>
      <div class="stat-note">Mỗi điểm: +3% HP và +10% tốc độ hồi máu</div>
      <div class="stat-row"><span style="color:#8dff67">Sword</span><span class="stat-value" id="statSword">0</span><button class="stat-plus" data-stat="sword">+</button></div>
      <div class="available-points">Available Points: <span id="availablePoints">0</span> · Max 150</div>
    </div>

    <button class="item-toggle" id="itemToggle">Item</button>
    <div class="item-panel" id="itemPanel">
      <div class="item-title">ITEM</div>
      <div class="item-row">💰 Tiền: <b id="itemMoney">0</b></div>
      <div class="item-row">🗝️ Boss Key: <b id="itemKeys">0</b></div>
      <div class="item-row">❄️ Ice Breath Dragon: <b id="itemSword">Chưa sở hữu</b></div>
      <div class="item-row">🔥 Flame Dragon Breath: <b id="itemFlameSword">Chưa sở hữu</b></div>
      <div class="item-row">✨ Gold Kitana: <b id="itemGoldSword">Chưa sở hữu</b></div>
      <div class="item-row">🟣 ???: <b id="itemMysterySword">Mở khóa sau update</b></div>
      <div class="item-row">🥋 Võ V2: <b id="itemV2">Chưa mở khóa</b></div>
      <div class="item-row">🗺️ Khu vực: <b id="itemIsland">Đảo Khởi Đầu</b></div>
    </div>

    <div class="mobile-controls">
      <div class="joystick" id="joystick"><div class="joystick-knob" id="joystickKnob"></div></div>
      <button class="mobile-m1" id="mobileM1">M1</button>
    </div>

    <div class="safe-zone-label" id="safeZoneLabel">SAFE ZONE</div>
    <div class="safe-zone-label" id="dimensionLabel" style="top:46px;background:rgba(120,40,180,.2);border-color:rgba(190,90,255,.55);color:#e0a7ff;">HIDDEN DIMENSION</div>

    <div class="npc-modal" id="boatNpcModal">
      <div class="npc-modal-box">
        <div class="npc-modal-title">🚤 nexx8n — Người lái thuyền</div>
        <div class="npc-modal-sub">Chọn đảo muốn đi. Đảo Rừng yêu cầu level 25.</div>
        <div class="npc-choice-grid">
          <button class="npc-choice" id="boatGoIsland1">Đảo 1<small>Đảo Khởi Đầu · quái và boss cũ</small></button>
          <button class="npc-choice" id="boatGoIsland2">Đảo 2<small>Đảo Rừng · Lv.25+</small></button>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js"></script>
<script>
const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab');
const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.panel');
const sidebarFiles = document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-file[data-tab]');
const breadcrumbFile = document.getElementById('breadcrumbFile');

function setActiveTab(tabName) {
  tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.tab === tabName));
  panels.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === 'panel-' + tabName));
  sidebarFiles.forEach(f => f.classList.toggle('active', f.dataset.tab === tabName));
  breadcrumbFile.textContent = tabName + '.js';
}
tabs.forEach(tab => tab.addEventListener('click', () => setActiveTab(tab.dataset.tab)));
sidebarFiles.forEach(f => f.addEventListener('click', () => setActiveTab(f.dataset.tab)));

const loadingOverlay = document.getElementById('loadingOverlay');
const storageStatus = document.getElementById('storageStatus');
const sessionStatus = document.getElementById('sessionStatus');
const acctCount = document.getElementById('acctCount');
const acctList = document.getElementById('acctList');

function showMsg(el, text, type) {
  el.textContent = text;
  el.className = 'msg show ' + type;
}

async function loadAccounts() {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('devauth:accounts');
    if (!saved) return [];

    const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      localStorage.removeItem('devauth:accounts');
      return [];
    }

    return parsed.filter(acc =>
      acc &&
      typeof acc.username === 'string' &&
      (
        typeof acc.password === 'string' ||
        acc.provider === 'google'
      )
    );
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Không đọc được tài khoản:', e);
    localStorage.removeItem('devauth:accounts');
    return [];
  }
}

async function saveAccounts(accounts) {
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
}

function renderAccounts(accounts) {
  acctCount.textContent = accounts.length;
  acctList.innerHTML = '';
  accounts.forEach((acc, i) => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'account-row';
    const tag = acc.provider === 'google' ? ' <span style="color:#45454a;">[google]</span>' : '';
    row.innerHTML = `<span class="name">${acc.username}${tag}</span><button class="del-btn" data-i="${i}">xóa</button>`;
    acctList.appendChild(row);
  });
  acctList.querySelectorAll('.del-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const accounts = await loadAccounts();
      accounts.splice(Number(btn.dataset.i), 1);
      await saveAccounts(accounts);
      renderAccounts(accounts);
    });
  });
}

async function init() {
  loadingOverlay.classList.add('show');
  const accounts = await loadAccounts();
  renderAccounts(accounts);
  storageStatus.textContent = 'local connected';
  loadingOverlay.classList.remove('show');
}
init();

/* ---------- Chuyển màn hình auth <-> map ---------- */
const screenAuth = document.getElementById('screen-auth');
const screenMap = document.getElementById('screen-map');
const mapSessionTag = document.getElementById('mapSessionTag');
let leafletMapInstance = null;

function goToMapScreen(displayName) {
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:currentUser', displayName);
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:loggedIn', 'true');
  sessionStatus.textContent = 'session: ' + displayName;
  showDeviceScreen();
}

document.getElementById('btnBackToAuth').addEventListener('click', logoutAccount);

document.getElementById('btnRegister').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const user = document.getElementById('regUser').value.trim();
  const pass = document.getElementById('regPass').value;
  const pass2 = document.getElementById('regPass2').value;
  const msg = document.getElementById('regMsg');

  if (!user || !pass) {
    showMsg(msg, 'lỗi: username / password không được để trống', 'error');
    return;
  }
  if (pass !== pass2) {
    showMsg(msg, 'lỗi: mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp', 'error');
    return;
  }
  if (pass.length < 4) {
    showMsg(msg, 'lỗi: mật khẩu cần tối thiểu 4 ký tự', 'error');
    return;
  }

  const accounts = await loadAccounts();
  if (accounts.some(a => a.username.toLowerCase() === user.toLowerCase())) {
    showMsg(msg, 'lỗi: username đã tồn tại', 'error');
    return;
  }

  accounts.push({ username: user, password: pass });
  await saveAccounts(accounts);
  renderAccounts(accounts);
  showMsg(msg, 'thành công: tài khoản "' + user + '" đã được tạo', 'success');

  document.getElementById('loginUser').value = user;
  document.getElementById('loginPass').value = pass;
  document.getElementById('regUser').value = '';
  document.getElementById('regPass').value = '';
  document.getElementById('regPass2').value = '';

  setTimeout(() => setActiveTab('login'), 500);
});

document.getElementById('btnLogin').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const user = document.getElementById('loginUser').value.trim();
  const pass = document.getElementById('loginPass').value;
  const msg = document.getElementById('loginMsg');

  if (!user || !pass) {
    showMsg(msg, 'lỗi: vui lòng nhập đủ thông tin', 'error');
    return;
  }

  const accounts = await loadAccounts();
  const found = accounts.find(a =>
    typeof a.username === 'string' &&
    typeof a.password === 'string' &&
    a.username.toLowerCase() === user.toLowerCase() &&
    a.password === pass
  );

  if (found) {
    showMsg(msg, 'thành công: xin chào, ' + found.username, 'success');
    sessionStatus.textContent = 'session: ' + found.username;
    setTimeout(() => goToMapScreen(found.username), 500);
  } else {
    showMsg(msg, 'lỗi: sai username hoặc password', 'error');
    sessionStatus.textContent = 'no session';
  }
});



document.querySelectorAll('#screen-auth input').forEach(inp => {
  inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      const panel = inp.closest('.panel').id;
      if (panel === 'panel-login') document.getElementById('btnLogin').click();
      else document.getElementById('btnRegister').click();
    }
  });
});

/* ===== TỰ ĐĂNG NHẬP + CHỌN PHE + GAME ===== */
const screenDevice = document.getElementById('screen-device');
const screenFaction = document.getElementById('screen-faction');
const screenGame = document.getElementById('screen-game');

function hideAllScreens() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
}

function logoutAccount() {
  localStorage.removeItem('devauth:loggedIn');
  localStorage.removeItem('devauth:currentUser');
  hideAllScreens();
  screenAuth.classList.add('active');
  sessionStatus.textContent = 'no session';
}

function showDeviceScreen() {
  const user = localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
  if (!user) return logoutAccount();
  hideAllScreens();
  screenDevice.classList.add('active');
}

function showFactionScreen() {
  const user = localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
  if (!user) return logoutAccount();
  document.getElementById('factionUser').textContent = user;
  hideAllScreens();
  screenFaction.classList.add('active');
}

function showFactionOrGame() {
  const user = localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
  if (!user) return logoutAccount();
  document.getElementById('factionUser').textContent = user;
  document.getElementById('hudUser').textContent = user;
  hideAllScreens();
  const faction = localStorage.getItem('devauth:faction:' + user);
  if (faction === 'fire' || faction === 'ice' || faction === 'wind') {
    screenGame.classList.add('active');
    applyDeviceMode();
    startGame();
  } else {
    screenFaction.classList.add('active');
  }
}


document.getElementById('choosePC').addEventListener('click', () => {
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:device', 'pc');
  showFactionScreen();
});
document.getElementById('chooseMobile').addEventListener('click', () => {
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:device', 'mobile');
  showFactionScreen();
});
document.getElementById('logoutDevice').addEventListener('click', logoutAccount);

function applyDeviceMode() {
  const mobile = localStorage.getItem('devauth:device') === 'mobile';
  document.body.classList.toggle('mobile-mode', mobile);
  controlHint.textContent = mobile ? 'Di chuyển: con lăn' : 'Di chuyển: WASD / mũi tên';
  m1Hint.textContent = mobile ? 'M1: nút bên phải' : 'M1: Chuột trái';
}

document.getElementById('chooseFire').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const user = localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:faction:' + user, 'fire');
  showFactionOrGame();
});
document.getElementById('chooseIce').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const user = localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:faction:' + user, 'ice');
  showFactionOrGame();
});
document.getElementById('chooseWind').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const user = localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:faction:' + user, 'wind');
  showFactionOrGame();
});
document.getElementById('chooseLightning').addEventListener('click', () => { alert('Phe Lôi chưa được cập nhật!'); });

document.getElementById('logoutFaction').addEventListener('click', logoutAccount);
document.getElementById('logoutGame').addEventListener('click', logoutAccount);

const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const keys = {};
let gameStarted = false;
let animationId = null;
let lastTime = 0;
let effects = [];
let enemies = [];
let projectiles = [];
let skillCooldown = { z:0, x:0, c:0 };
let m1Cooldown=0,m1Combo=0,lastM1Time=0;
let joystickVector = {x:0,y:0};
let regenAccumulator = 0;
let currentDimension = 'world';
let currentIsland = 'starter';
let hiddenBossSkillCooldown = 0;

const playerObj = { x:460, y:270, r:16, speed:210, hp:100, maxHp:100, facingX:1, facingY:0 };
const swordSeller = { x:760, y:390, r:20, name:'REALNAH' };
const boatSeller = { x:300, y:445, r:21, name:'nexx8n' };
const factionChanger = { x:610, y:105, r:21, name:'ĐỔI PHE' };
const v2Trainer = { x:155, y:115, r:21, name:'nowaytosay' };
const sellerAvatar = new Image(); sellerAvatar.src = 'data:image/png;base64,';
const iceSwordImage = new Image(); iceSwordImage.src = 'data:image/png;base64,';
const flameSwordImage = new Image(); flameSwordImage.src = 'data:image/png;base64,';
const goldSwordImage = new Image(); goldSwordImage.src = 'data:image/png;base64,';
function equippedSword(){ const p=loadProgress(); return p.equippedWeapon; }
function usingSword(){ const p=loadProgress(); return (p.equippedWeapon==='iceBreathDragon'&&p.ownedSwords?.iceBreathDragon)||(p.equippedWeapon==='flameDragonBreath'&&p.ownedSwords?.flameDragonBreath)||(p.equippedWeapon==='goldKitana'&&p.ownedSwords?.goldKitana); }
function currentFaction(){ return localStorage.getItem('devauth:faction:' + localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser')) || 'fire'; }

function progressKey() {
  return 'devauth:progress:' + localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
}
function loadProgress() {
  const fallback = {
    npc:0,boss:0,level:1,exp:0,points:0,money:0,keys:0,
    stats:{melee:0,defense:0,sword:0},ownedSwords:{iceBreathDragon:false,flameDragonBreath:false,goldKitana:false},equippedWeapon:'melee',island:'starter',v2Quest:{accepted:false,startBoss:0},fightingV2:false
  };
  try {
    const p = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(progressKey())) || fallback;
    p.level ??= 1; p.exp ??= 0; p.points ??= 0; p.money ??= 0; p.keys ??= 0;
    p.stats ??= {melee:0,defense:0,sword:0};
    for (const k of ['melee','defense','sword']) p.stats[k] ??= 0;
    p.ownedSwords ??= {iceBreathDragon:false,flameDragonBreath:false};
    p.ownedSwords.iceBreathDragon ??= false;
    p.ownedSwords.flameDragonBreath ??= false;
    p.ownedSwords.goldKitana ??= false;
    p.equippedWeapon ??= 'melee';
    p.island ??= 'starter';
    delete p.stats.gun;
    delete p.stats.fruit;
    return p;
  } catch { return fallback; }
}
function saveProgress(p) {
  const key=progressKey();
  if(!key.endsWith('null')) localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(p));
}
function persistCurrentProgress(){
  const user=localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
  if(user) saveProgress(loadProgress());
}
window.addEventListener('beforeunload',persistCurrentProgress);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='hidden')persistCurrentProgress();});
function expNeeded(level) {
  // Lv 1 cần 86 EXP, mỗi level sau tăng 10%.
  return Math.round(86 * Math.pow(1.10, level - 1));
}
function statMultiplier(value) {
  return 1 + Math.floor(value / 10) * 0.15;
}
function gainExp(amount) {
  const p = loadProgress();
  if (p.level >= 150) {
    p.level = 150;
    p.exp = 0;
    saveProgress(p);
    return;
  }

  p.exp += amount;
  while (p.level < 150 && p.exp >= expNeeded(p.level)) {
    p.exp -= expNeeded(p.level);
    p.level++;
    p.points += 3;
    showGameMsg('Lên cấp ' + p.level + ' · +3 điểm stats');
  }

  if (p.level >= 150) {
    p.level = 150;
    p.exp = 0;
  }

  saveProgress(p);
}
function defenseHpMultiplier(defense) {
  return 1 + defense * 0.03;
}
function regenPerSecond(defense) {
  // Hồi cơ bản 5 HP/s; mỗi điểm Defense tăng 10%.
  return 5 * (1 + defense * 0.10);
}
function refreshDerivedStats() {
  const p = loadProgress();
  playerObj.maxHp = Math.round(100 * defenseHpMultiplier(p.stats.defense));
  if (playerObj.hp > playerObj.maxHp) playerObj.hp = playerObj.maxHp;
}
function updateHUD() {
  const p = loadProgress();
  refreshDerivedStats();
  hudNpc.textContent = p.npc;
  hudBoss.textContent = p.boss;
  hudHp.textContent = Math.max(0, Math.round(playerObj.hp)) + '/' + playerObj.maxHp;
  hudRegen.textContent = regenPerSecond(p.stats.defense).toFixed(1);
  hudLevel.textContent = p.level;
  hudExp.textContent = p.exp;
  hudExpNeed.textContent = expNeeded(p.level);
  levelText.textContent = p.level;
  expText.textContent = p.exp + ' / ' + expNeeded(p.level);
  expBar.style.width = Math.min(100, p.exp / expNeeded(p.level) * 100) + '%';

  statMelee.textContent = p.stats.melee;
  statDefense.textContent = p.stats.defense;
  statSword.textContent = p.stats.sword;
  availablePoints.textContent = p.points;
  moneyText.textContent = p.money.toLocaleString('vi-VN');
  keyText.textContent = p.keys;

  const ice = currentFaction() === 'ice';
  const wind = currentFaction() === 'wind';
  const weapon = equippedSword();
  const swordMode = usingSword();
  const flameSword = weapon === 'flameDragonBreath';
  const goldSword = weapon === 'goldKitana';
  gameFaction.textContent = goldSword ? 'KIẾM VÀNG' : (flameSword ? 'KIẾM LỬA' : (swordMode ? 'KIẾM BĂNG' : (ice ? 'BĂNG' : (wind ? 'PHONG' : 'HỎA'))));
  fightingStyleTitle.textContent = goldSword ? 'GOLD KITANA' : (flameSword ? 'FLAME DRAGON BREATH' : (swordMode ? 'ICE BREATH DRAGON' : (ice ? 'BĂNG QUYỀN' : (wind ? 'PHONG QUYỀN' : 'DRAGON TALON'))));
  let unlocked;
  if(goldSword){
    skillNameZ.innerHTML = 'Bão Long Thiên<br><small>Nhát trảm vàng · Dame 300 · cần 15 NPC</small>';
    skillNameX.innerHTML = 'Long Hình Cẩm Lý<br><small>Rồng lao tới + lướt trảm · Dame 436 · cần 30 NPC</small>';
    skillNameC.innerHTML = 'Kim Long Chấn Thiên<br><small>Rồng vàng cung đình · Dame 501 · cần 45 NPC + 3 Boss</small>';
    unlocked={z:p.npc>=15,x:p.npc>=30,c:p.npc>=45&&p.boss>=3};
  } else if(flameSword){
    skillNameZ.innerHTML = 'Hỏa Thương<br><small>Phóng giáo lửa · Dame 52 · cần 10 NPC</small>';
    skillNameX.innerHTML = 'Hỏa Nhân Quy Tiên<br><small>100.000 nhát chém + nổ · Dame 129 · cần 20 NPC</small>';
    skillNameC.innerHTML = 'Hỏa Thiên Đền Diệt Trảm<br><small>Khống chế 3 giây · tổng Dame 349 · cần 30 NPC + 1 Boss</small>';
    unlocked={z:p.npc>=10,x:p.npc>=20,c:p.npc>=30&&p.boss>=1};
  } else if(swordMode){
    skillNameZ.innerHTML = 'Băng Chi Diệm<br><small>Laser băng phát nổ · Dame 70 · cần 15 NPC</small>';
    skillNameX.innerHTML = 'Băng Sát Phạt<br><small>Đền băng + 100 nhát trảm · Dame 135 · cần 25 NPC + 1 Boss</small>';
    skillNameC.innerHTML = 'Băng Long Thiên Trảm<br><small>Rồng băng lao xuống và chém nổ · Dame 220 · cần 20 NPC + 3 Boss</small>';
    unlocked={z:p.npc>=15,x:p.npc>=25&&p.boss>=1,c:p.npc>=20&&p.boss>=3};
  } else {
    skillNameZ.innerHTML = ice ? 'Băng Quyền Cung<br><small>15 mũi tên băng · Dame 39 · cần 10 NPC</small>' : (wind ? 'Phong Cước Truy Kích<br><small>Bay tới đá đối thủ · Dame 40 · cần 10 NPC</small>' : 'Hỏa Tứ Quyền<br><small>Nhiệm vụ: hạ 10 NPC</small>');
    skillNameX.innerHTML = ice ? 'Băng Sát Phạt<br><small>Lao tới đấm 4 lần · Dame 51 · cần 20 NPC</small>' : (wind ? 'Lốc Phong Tỏa Mục Tiêu<br><small>Auto aim tạo lốc tại mục tiêu · Dame 60 · cần 20 NPC</small>' : 'Hỏa Hóa Tiên Cung<br><small>Nhiệm vụ: hạ 20 NPC</small>');
    skillNameC.innerHTML = ice ? 'Băng La Sát<br><small>Vòng băng → bông tuyết → nổ · Dame 89 · cần 30 NPC + 1 Boss</small>' : (wind ? 'Thiên Phong Chấn Bạo<br><small>Bay tới, đấm đất tạo siêu bão · Dame 130 · cần 30 NPC</small>' : 'Cửu Ngũ Cung Loạn Hỏa<br><small>Nhiệm vụ: hạ 30 NPC + 1 Boss</small>');
    unlocked={z:p.npc>=10,x:p.npc>=20,c:p.npc>=30&&(wind||p.boss>=1)};
  }
  if(document.getElementById('iceSwordState')) iceSwordState.textContent = p.ownedSwords.iceBreathDragon ? (weapon==='iceBreathDragon'?'Đang trang bị':'Đã sở hữu') : 'Chưa sở hữu';
  if(document.getElementById('flameSwordState')) flameSwordState.textContent = p.ownedSwords.flameDragonBreath ? (weapon==='flameDragonBreath'?'Đang trang bị':'Đã sở hữu') : 'Chưa sở hữu';
  if(document.getElementById('goldSwordState')) goldSwordState.textContent = p.ownedSwords.goldKitana ? (weapon==='goldKitana'?'Đang trang bị':'Đã sở hữu') : 'Chưa sở hữu';
  skillZ.classList.toggle('locked', !unlocked.z);
  skillX.classList.toggle('locked', !unlocked.x);
  skillC.classList.toggle('locked', !unlocked.c);
  unlockCount.textContent = Object.values(unlocked).filter(Boolean).length;
  if(p.island==='forest' && p.level<25) p.island='starter';
  currentIsland = p.island || 'starter';
  const islandName = currentIsland==='void' ? 'Đảo Hắc Tử' : (currentIsland==='forest' ? 'Đảo Rừng' : 'Đảo Khởi Đầu');
  islandText.textContent=islandName; islandHint.textContent=currentIsland==='void'?'Đảo 3 · vùng đất bí ẩn':(currentIsland==='forest'?'Quái 300 HP · Boss 1500 HP':'Đảo Rừng mở ở level 25');
  itemMoney.textContent=p.money.toLocaleString('vi-VN'); itemKeys.textContent=p.keys; itemSword.textContent=p.ownedSwords.iceBreathDragon?'Đã sở hữu':'Chưa sở hữu'; itemFlameSword.textContent=p.ownedSwords.flameDragonBreath?'Đã sở hữu':'Chưa sở hữu'; if(document.getElementById('itemGoldSword')) itemGoldSword.textContent=p.ownedSwords.goldKitana?'Đã sở hữu':'Chưa sở hữu'; if(document.getElementById('itemMysterySword')) itemMysterySword.textContent='Mở khóa sau update'; if(document.getElementById('itemV2')) itemV2.textContent=p.fightingV2?'Đã mở khóa':'Chưa mở khóa'; itemIsland.textContent=islandName;
  if(document.getElementById('goldSwordCard')) goldSwordCard.style.display=currentIsland==='forest'?'block':'none';
}
function showGameMsg(t) {
  gameMsg.textContent = t;
  gameMsg.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(showGameMsg.timer);
  showGameMsg.timer = setTimeout(()=>gameMsg.classList.remove('show'), 1200);
}
function spawnEnemy(isBoss=false, isHiddenBoss=false) {
  const forest = currentIsland === 'forest';
  const voidIsland = currentIsland === 'void';
  const hp = isHiddenBoss ? 9500 : (voidIsland ? (isBoss ? 3200 : 650) : (forest ? (isBoss ? 1500 : 300) : (isBoss ? 250 : 50)));
  enemies.push({
    x: isHiddenBoss ? canvas.width - 110 : 50 + Math.random()*(canvas.width-100),
    y: isHiddenBoss ? 110 : 60 + Math.random()*(canvas.height-120),
    r: isHiddenBoss ? 42 : (isBoss ? 28 : 14), hp, maxHp:hp,
    boss:isBoss || isHiddenBoss, hiddenBoss:isHiddenBoss, forest, voidIsland,
    speed:isHiddenBoss ? 48 : (isBoss ? 35 : 52)
  });
}
function resetArena() {
  enemies = [];
  if (currentDimension === 'hidden') {
    spawnEnemy(true, true);
    return;
  }
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++) spawnEnemy(false);
  spawnEnemy(true);
}
function damageEnemy(e, dmg) {
  const v2p=loadProgress();
  if(v2p.fightingV2 && v2p.equippedWeapon==='melee') dmg=Math.round(dmg*1.25);
  e.hp -= dmg;
  if (e.hp > 0) return;
  const p = loadProgress();
  if (e.hiddenBoss) {
    const reward = 50000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 29561);
    p.money += reward; p.boss++; saveProgress(p); gainExp(1800);
    showGameMsg('Hạ Boss Ẩn 9500 HP! +' + reward.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' tiền');
    setTimeout(()=>{ currentDimension='world'; dimensionLabel.classList.remove('show'); enemies=[]; resetArena(); setDimension('world'); showGameMsg('Đã quay về đảo'); },1400);
  } else if (e.boss) {
    const reward = e.voidIsland ? 12000 : (e.forest ? 6000 : (1000 + Math.floor(Math.random()*1006)));
    p.money += reward; p.boss++;
    if (Math.random() < 0.05) { p.keys++; saveProgress(p); showHiddenBossPrompt(); } else saveProgress(p);
    gainExp(e.voidIsland ? 800 : (e.forest ? 450 : 150));
    showGameMsg('Hạ Boss! +' + reward.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' tiền');
  } else {
    const reward = e.voidIsland ? 2400 : (e.forest ? 1200 : (90 + Math.floor(Math.random()*16)));
    p.money += reward; p.npc++; saveProgress(p); gainExp(e.voidIsland ? 190 : (e.forest ? 110 : 40 + Math.floor(Math.random()*8)));
    showGameMsg('+' + reward.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' tiền');
  }
  const i=enemies.indexOf(e); if(i>=0) enemies.splice(i,1);
  if(!e.hiddenBoss) setTimeout(()=>spawnEnemy(e.boss,false),e.boss?3500:900);
  updateHUD();
}
function nearestEnemy(maxDist=9999) {
  let best=null, bd=maxDist;
  enemies.forEach(e=>{
    const d=Math.hypot(e.x-playerObj.x,e.y-playerObj.y);
    if(d<bd){bd=d;best=e;}
  });
  return best;
}
function canUse(key, npc, boss, cd) {
  if (isInSafeZone(playerObj.x, playerObj.y)) {
    showGameMsg('Không thể dùng skill trong Safe Zone');
    return false;
  }
  const p=loadProgress(), now=performance.now();
  if(p.npc<npc || p.boss<boss){
    const requirement = boss > 0
      ? `${npc} NPC + ${boss} Boss`
      : `${npc} NPC`;
    showGameMsg(`Chưa mở ${key.toUpperCase()}: cần ${requirement}`);
    return false;
  }
  if(now < skillCooldown[key]) return false;
  skillCooldown[key]=now+cd;
  return true;
}
function toggleWeaponMode(){
  const p=loadProgress();
  const owned=[];
  if(p.ownedSwords.iceBreathDragon) owned.push('iceBreathDragon');
  if(p.ownedSwords.flameDragonBreath) owned.push('flameDragonBreath');
  if(p.ownedSwords.goldKitana) owned.push('goldKitana');
  if(!owned.length){showGameMsg('Mua kiếm từ REALNAH trước');return;}
  const cycle=['melee',...owned];
  const i=cycle.indexOf(p.equippedWeapon);
  p.equippedWeapon=cycle[(i+1)%cycle.length];
  saveProgress(p);skillCooldown={z:0,x:0,c:0};updateHUD();
  showGameMsg(p.equippedWeapon==='melee'?'Đã đổi về võ':(p.equippedWeapon==='goldKitana'?'Đã trang bị Gold Kitana':(p.equippedWeapon==='flameDragonBreath'?'Đã trang bị Flame Dragon Breath':'Đã trang bị Ice Breath Dragon')));
}

  const p=loadProgress(), dmg=Math.round(70*statMultiplier(p.stats.sword));

function useM1(){
  if(usingSword()){
    if (isInSafeZone(playerObj.x, playerObj.y)) { showGameMsg('Không thể tấn công trong Safe Zone'); return; }
    const now=performance.now(); if(now<m1Cooldown)return; m1Cooldown=now+320;
    const t=nearestEnemy(82); effects.push({type:equippedSword()==='goldKitana'?'goldSlashFx':'slash',x:playerObj.x+playerObj.facingX*35,y:playerObj.y+playerObj.facingY*35,angle:Math.atan2(playerObj.facingY,playerObj.facingX),life:.2,max:.2,size:42});
    if(t) damageEnemy(t,Math.round((equippedSword()==='goldKitana'?100:18)*statMultiplier(loadProgress().stats.sword)));
    return;
  }
  if (isInSafeZone(playerObj.x, playerObj.y)) { showGameMsg('Không thể tấn công trong Safe Zone'); return; }
  const now=performance.now(); if(now<m1Cooldown)return;
  if(now-lastM1Time>900)m1Combo=0;
  m1Combo=(m1Combo%4)+1; lastM1Time=now; m1Cooldown=now+(m1Combo===4?520:260);
  const t=nearestEnemy(m1Combo===4?78:65), ice=currentFaction()==='ice';
  effects.push({type:ice?'iceBurst':'burst',x:playerObj.x+playerObj.facingX*30,y:playerObj.y+playerObj.facingY*30,life:.18,max:.18,size:22});
  if(!t)return;
  const p=loadProgress();
  damageEnemy(t,Math.round((ice?9:20)*statMultiplier(p.stats.melee)));
}
