const safeZone = { x:40, y:40, w:190, h:150 };
const worldSpawn = { x:safeZone.x + safeZone.w/2, y:safeZone.y + safeZone.h/2 };
const dimensionSpawn = { x:120, y:canvas.height/2 };

function setDimension(name) {
  currentDimension = name;
  const inHidden = name === 'hidden';
  dimensionLabel.classList.toggle('show', inHidden);

  if (inHidden) {
    playerObj.x = dimensionSpawn.x;
    playerObj.y = dimensionSpawn.y;
  } else {
    playerObj.x = worldSpawn.x;
    playerObj.y = worldSpawn.y;
  }

  playerObj.hp = playerObj.maxHp;
}

function isInSafeZone(x, y) {
  if (currentDimension !== 'world') return false;
  return x >= safeZone.x &&
         x <= safeZone.x + safeZone.w &&
         y >= safeZone.y &&
         y <= safeZone.y + safeZone.h;
}

function showHiddenBossPrompt() {
  hiddenBossModal.classList.add('show');
}

declineHiddenBoss.addEventListener('click', () => {
  hiddenBossModal.classList.remove('show');
});

acceptHiddenBoss.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const p = loadProgress();

  if (p.keys <= 0) {
    hiddenBossModal.classList.remove('show');
    showGameMsg('Bạn không có Boss Key');
    return;
  }

  p.keys--;
  saveProgress(p);
  hiddenBossModal.classList.remove('show');

  // Dịch chuyển người chơi sang dimension riêng.
  currentDimension = 'hidden';
  dimensionLabel.classList.add('show');
  safeZoneLabel.classList.remove('show');
  enemies = [];
  projectiles = [];
  effects = [];
  setDimension('hidden');

  spawnEnemy(true, true);
  showGameMsg('Đã dịch chuyển tới Hidden Dimension!');
  updateHUD();
});

function startGame() {
  if(gameStarted) return;
  gameStarted = true;
  currentDimension = 'world';
  resetArena();
  setDimension('world');
  updateHUD();
  lastTime=performance.now();
  animationId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function loop(now) {
  const dt=Math.min(.033,(now-lastTime)/1000); lastTime=now;
  update(dt); draw();
  animationId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function update(dt) {
  let dx=(keys.d||keys.arrowright?1:0)-(keys.a||keys.arrowleft?1:0);
  let dy=(keys.s||keys.arrowdown?1:0)-(keys.w||keys.arrowup?1:0);
  if (localStorage.getItem('devauth:device') === 'mobile') {
    dx = joystickVector.x;
    dy = joystickVector.y;
  }
  const len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  if(len){ dx/=len; dy/=len; playerObj.facingX=dx; playerObj.facingY=dy; }
  playerObj.x=Math.max(18,Math.min(canvas.width-18,playerObj.x+dx*playerObj.speed*dt));
  playerObj.y=Math.max(18,Math.min(canvas.height-18,playerObj.y+dy*playerObj.speed*dt));

  // Hồi máu liên tục. Lv 1/Defense 0 = 5 HP mỗi giây.
  if (playerObj.hp > 0 && playerObj.hp < playerObj.maxHp) {
    const defense = loadProgress().stats.defense;
    playerObj.hp = Math.min(
      playerObj.maxHp,
      playerObj.hp + regenPerSecond(defense) * dt
    );
  }

  const playerSafe = isInSafeZone(playerObj.x, playerObj.y);
  safeZoneLabel.classList.toggle('show', playerSafe);
  dimensionLabel.classList.toggle('show', currentDimension === 'hidden');

  enemies.forEach(e=>{
    const ex=playerObj.x-e.x, ey=playerObj.y-e.y, d=Math.hypot(ex,ey)||1;

    if (playerSafe) {
      // Safe Zone chỉ dành cho người chơi.
      if (isInSafeZone(e.x, e.y)) {
        e.x = safeZone.x + safeZone.w + 24;
      }
      return;
    }

    if((e.stunnedUntil||0)>performance.now()) return;

    if (e.hiddenBoss) {
      // Boss Ẩn dùng skill gây đúng 90 damage, có hồi chiêu 2.8 giây.
      const now = performance.now();
      if (d <= 190 && now >= hiddenBossSkillCooldown) {
        hiddenBossSkillCooldown = now + 2800;
        effects.push({type:'ring',x:playerObj.x,y:playerObj.y,life:.65,max:.65,size:75});
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (currentDimension === 'hidden' && playerObj.hp > 0) {
            playerObj.hp -= 400;
            showGameMsg('Boss Ẩn tung đòn: -400 HP');
          }
        }, 420);
      }
    }

    if(d>30){
      const nextX = e.x + ex/d*e.speed*dt;
      const nextY = e.y + ey/d*e.speed*dt;

      if (currentDimension === 'hidden' || !isInSafeZone(nextX, nextY)) {
        e.x = nextX;
        e.y = nextY;
      }
    } else if (!e.hiddenBoss) {
      playerObj.hp -= (e.boss ? 10 : 4) * dt;
    }
  });
  if(playerObj.hp<=0){
    playerObj.hp=playerObj.maxHp;

    if(currentDimension==='hidden'){
      playerObj.x=dimensionSpawn.x;
      playerObj.y=dimensionSpawn.y;
      showGameMsg('Hồi sinh trong Hidden Dimension');
    } else {
      playerObj.x=worldSpawn.x;
      playerObj.y=worldSpawn.y;
      showGameMsg('Hồi sinh tại Safe Zone');
    }
  }
  projectiles.slice().forEach((p)=>{
    const i=projectiles.indexOf(p); if(i<0)return;
    if(p.type==='iceLaser'){
      p.trail.push({x:p.x,y:p.y}); if(p.trail.length>12)p.trail.shift();
      p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.life-=dt;
      const hit=enemies.find(e=>Math.hypot(e.x-p.x,e.y-p.y)<e.r+12);
      if(hit || p.life<=0 || p.x<0 || p.x>canvas.width || p.y<0 || p.y>canvas.height){
        const ex=hit?hit.x:p.x,ey=hit?hit.y:p.y; projectiles.splice(i,1);
        effects.push({type:'iceBurst',x:ex,y:ey,life:.75,max:.75,size:95});
        enemies.slice().forEach(e=>{if(Math.hypot(e.x-ex,e.y-ey)<100)damageEnemy(e,p.damage);});
      }
      return;
    }
    if(p.type==='iceArrow'){
      p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.life-=dt;
      const hit=enemies.find(e=>Math.hypot(e.x-p.x,e.y-p.y)<e.r+8);
      if(hit){ damageEnemy(hit,p.damage); projectiles.splice(i,1); effects.push({type:'iceBurst',x:p.x,y:p.y,life:.22,max:.22,size:18}); }
      else if(p.life<=0 || p.x<0 || p.x>canvas.width || p.y<0 || p.y>canvas.height) projectiles.splice(i,1);
      return;
    }
    if(p.type==='windBlade'){ p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.life-=dt; const hit=enemies.find(e=>Math.hypot(e.x-p.x,e.y-p.y)<e.r+12); if(hit){damageEnemy(hit,p.damage);projectiles.splice(i,1);effects.push({type:'windRing',x:p.x,y:p.y,life:.3,max:.3,size:45});} else if(p.life<=0||p.x<0||p.x>canvas.width||p.y<0||p.y>canvas.height)projectiles.splice(i,1); return;}
    if(!p.target || !enemies.includes(p.target)){projectiles.splice(i,1);return;}
    const dx=p.target.x-p.x,dy=p.target.y-p.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    p.x+=dx/d*p.speed*dt;p.y+=dy/d*p.speed*dt;p.life-=dt;
    if(d<18 || p.life<=0){ const t=p.target; projectiles.splice(i,1); explodeC(t); }
  });
  effects.forEach((e,i)=>{ e.life-=dt; if(e.life<=0) effects.splice(i,1); });
  updateHUD();
}
function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  ctx.fillStyle=currentDimension==='hidden'?'#160b1d':'#101012';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#1b1b1f';ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<canvas.width;x+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,canvas.height);ctx.stroke();}
  for(let y=0;y<canvas.height;y+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(canvas.width,y);ctx.stroke();}

  if (currentDimension === 'world') {
    // Đảo thay đổi theo level.
    if(currentIsland==='void'){ctx.fillStyle='#120b1f';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);for(let i=0;i<38;i++){const x=(i*149)%canvas.width,y=(i*97)%canvas.height;ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#29144a':'#3d1f66';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,10+(i%5)*5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}ctx.fillStyle='#4b3263';ctx.fillRect(0,240,canvas.width,70);} else if(currentIsland==='forest'){ ctx.fillStyle='#17351f';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height); for(let i=0;i<30;i++){const x=(i*137)%canvas.width,y=(i*83)%canvas.height;ctx.fillStyle='#275b32';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,22+(i%4)*5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();} ctx.fillStyle='#80603e';ctx.fillRect(0,240,canvas.width,70); }
    else {
    ctx.fillStyle='#24272d'; ctx.fillRect(0,215,canvas.width,115);
    ctx.fillStyle='#454b52'; ctx.fillRect(0,205,canvas.width,10); ctx.fillRect(0,330,canvas.width,10);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#d8bd58'; ctx.setLineDash([25,18]); ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,272); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width,272); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
    const buildings=[[270,35,150,130],[455,45,130,115],[620,30,250,140],[275,365,180,135],[490,375,130,120],[655,355,220,145]];
    buildings.forEach((b,i)=>{ ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#252f3a':'#303842'; ctx.fillRect(...b); ctx.strokeStyle='#55616d'; ctx.strokeRect(...b); for(let wx=b[0]+18;wx<b[0]+b[2]-10;wx+=34)for(let wy=b[1]+18;wy<b[1]+b[3]-12;wy+=30){ctx.fillStyle='#91c9e8';ctx.fillRect(wx,wy,14,10);} }); }

    // Safe Zone: chỉ người chơi vào được, quái không thể bước vào.
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(50,180,90,.12)';
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(80,220,120,.65)';
    ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.fillRect(safeZone.x,safeZone.y,safeZone.w,safeZone.h);
    ctx.strokeRect(safeZone.x,safeZone.y,safeZone.w,safeZone.h);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9dffb2';
    ctx.font='12px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('SAFE ZONE',safeZone.x+safeZone.w/2,safeZone.y+18);
    ctx.restore();
  } else {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(190,90,255,.24)';
    ctx.lineWidth=2;
    for(let r=70;r<420;r+=70){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2,r,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  enemies.forEach(e=>{
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(e.x,e.y,e.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=e.hiddenBoss?'#4b0d65':(e.boss?'#8b1e1e':'#555');ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#111';ctx.fillRect(e.x-e.r,e.y-e.r-9,e.r*2,4);
    ctx.fillStyle=e.hiddenBoss?'#d66bff':(e.boss?'#ff4747':'#ddd');ctx.fillRect(e.x-e.r,e.y-e.r-9,e.r*2*(e.hp/e.maxHp),4);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='10px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(e.hiddenBoss?'BOSS ẨN':(e.boss?'BOSS':'NPC'),e.x,e.y+3);
  });

  projectiles.forEach(p=>{
    ctx.save();
    if(p.type==='iceLaser'){ ctx.strokeStyle='#8feaff';ctx.lineWidth=8;ctx.shadowBlur=18;ctx.shadowColor='#70dfff';ctx.beginPath();const start=p.trail[0]||{x:p.x,y:p.y};ctx.moveTo(start.x,start.y);p.trail.forEach(q=>ctx.lineTo(q.x,q.y));ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,8,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='#e9fcff';ctx.fill(); }
    else if(p.type==='windBlade'){ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(p.vy,p.vx));ctx.strokeStyle='#baffd2';ctx.lineWidth=6;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,18,-1.1,1.1);ctx.stroke();}
    else if(p.type==='iceArrow'){ ctx.translate(p.x,p.y); ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(p.vy,p.vx)); ctx.fillStyle='#b9efff'; ctx.fillRect(-10,-2,20,4); ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(12,0);ctx.lineTo(5,-5);ctx.lineTo(5,5);ctx.fill(); }
    else {ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,10,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a00';ctx.fill();}
    ctx.restore();
  });
  effects.forEach(e=>{
    const alpha=Math.max(0,e.life/e.max);
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
    const ice=e.type==='iceBurst'||e.type==='iceRing'||e.type==='snowflake'||e.type==='iceTemple'||e.type==='slash'; const wind=e.type==='windRing'; const fire=e.type==='fireTemple'||e.type==='fireSlash'||e.type==='fireSpear';
    ctx.strokeStyle=wind?'#9dffc0':(ice?'#aeeeff':'#ff6a00');ctx.fillStyle=wind?'rgba(100,255,160,.25)':(ice?'rgba(100,210,255,.34)':'rgba(255,70,0,.32)');
    if(e.type==='fireSpear'){ctx.strokeStyle='#ff9a24';ctx.lineWidth=12;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(e.x,e.y);ctx.lineTo(e.tx,e.ty);ctx.stroke();}
    else if(e.type==='fireTemple'){ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);ctx.strokeStyle='#ff7424';ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,70,0,.14)';ctx.lineWidth=6;ctx.fillRect(-e.size/2,-e.size/2,e.size,e.size);ctx.strokeRect(-e.size/2,-e.size/2,e.size,e.size);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-e.size/2,-e.size/2);ctx.lineTo(0,-e.size/2-65);ctx.lineTo(e.size/2,-e.size/2);ctx.stroke();}
    else if(e.type==='iceTemple'){ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);ctx.strokeStyle='#8feaff';ctx.fillStyle='rgba(75,185,255,.12)';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.fillRect(-e.size/2,-e.size/2,e.size,e.size);ctx.strokeRect(-e.size/2,-e.size/2,e.size,e.size);for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i*45,-e.size/2);ctx.lineTo(i*45,e.size/2);ctx.stroke();}ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-e.size/2,-e.size/2);ctx.lineTo(0,-e.size/2-55);ctx.lineTo(e.size/2,-e.size/2);ctx.stroke();}
    else if(e.type==='slash'||e.type==='fireSlash'){ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);ctx.rotate(e.angle||0);ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-e.size/2,0);ctx.lineTo(e.size/2,0);ctx.stroke();}
    else if(e.type==='ring'||e.type==='iceRing'||e.type==='windRing'){ctx.lineWidth=8;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(e.x,e.y,e.size*(1-alpha*.4),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();}
    else if(e.type==='snowflake'){ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);ctx.lineWidth=7;for(let i=0;i<6;i++){ctx.rotate(Math.PI/3);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);ctx.lineTo(e.size*(1-alpha*.25),0);ctx.stroke();}}
    else {ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(e.x,e.y,e.size*(1-alpha*.3),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
    ctx.restore();
  });

  if(currentDimension==='world'){
    ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(swordSeller.x,swordSeller.y,24,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.clip();if(sellerAvatar.complete)ctx.drawImage(sellerAvatar,swordSeller.x-24,swordSeller.y-24,48,48);else{ctx.fillStyle='#69c9ff';ctx.fill();}ctx.restore();ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(swordSeller.x,swordSeller.y,24,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='11px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('REALNAH',swordSeller.x,swordSeller.y-31);ctx.fillText('Bán kiếm · nhấn E',swordSeller.x,swordSeller.y+40);
    if(currentIsland==='forest'){ctx.fillStyle='#5a2c91';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(v2Trainer.x,v2Trainer.y,v2Trainer.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#e2b5ff';ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='11px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('nowaytosay',v2Trainer.x,v2Trainer.y-31);ctx.fillText('Nâng Võ V2 · nhấn E',v2Trainer.x,v2Trainer.y+40);}

    // NPC bán thuyền nexx8n
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boatSeller.x,boatSeller.y,boatSeller.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='#3b8eea';ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#d9efff';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='11px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('nexx8n',boatSeller.x,boatSeller.y-30);ctx.fillText('Bán thuyền · nhấn E',boatSeller.x,boatSeller.y+38);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fd6ff';ctx.fillRect(boatSeller.x-13,boatSeller.y-5,26,10);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(boatSeller.x-18,boatSeller.y+5);ctx.lineTo(boatSeller.x+18,boatSeller.y+5);ctx.lineTo(boatSeller.x+10,boatSeller.y+13);ctx.lineTo(boatSeller.x-10,boatSeller.y+13);ctx.fill();

    // NPC đổi phe
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(factionChanger.x,factionChanger.y,factionChanger.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='#9b63e8';ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#eadcff';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='11px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('NPC ĐỔI PHE',factionChanger.x,factionChanger.y-30);ctx.fillText('Chọn lại phe · nhấn E',factionChanger.x,factionChanger.y+38);
    ctx.font='20px monospace';ctx.fillText('↻',factionChanger.x,factionChanger.y+7);
  }
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(playerObj.x,playerObj.y,playerObj.r,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=currentFaction()==='ice'?'#79dcff':(currentFaction()==='wind'?'#72efa0':'#ff7a00');ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
  if(usingSword()){const wi=equippedSword()==='goldKitana'?goldSwordImage:(equippedSword()==='flameDragonBreath'?flameSwordImage:iceSwordImage);if(wi.complete){ctx.save();ctx.translate(playerObj.x,playerObj.y);ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(playerObj.facingY,playerObj.facingX)+Math.PI/2);ctx.drawImage(wi,-10,-42,20,54);ctx.restore();}}
}


statsToggle.addEventListener('click',()=>statsPanel.classList.toggle('open'));
itemToggle.addEventListener('click',()=>itemPanel.classList.toggle('open'));
document.querySelectorAll('.stat-plus').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const p=loadProgress(), key=btn.dataset.stat;
    if(p.points<=0){showGameMsg('Không còn điểm stats');return;}
    if(p.stats[key]>=150){showGameMsg('Stats đã tối đa 150');return;}
    const oldMaxHp = playerObj.maxHp;
    const oldHpRatio = oldMaxHp > 0 ? playerObj.hp / oldMaxHp : 1;
    p.stats[key]++; p.points--;
    saveProgress(p);
    refreshDerivedStats();
    if (key === 'defense') {
      playerObj.hp = Math.min(playerObj.maxHp, playerObj.maxHp * oldHpRatio);
    }
    updateHUD();
  });
});

document.querySelectorAll('.skill-use').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const k=btn.dataset.skill;
    if(k==='z')useZ();
    if(k==='x')useX();
    if(k==='c')useC();
  });
});

closeSwordShop.addEventListener('click',()=>swordShopModal.classList.remove('show'));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-buy-sword]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const p=loadProgress(),id=b.dataset.buySword;
  const names={iceBreathDragon:'Ice Breath Dragon',flameDragonBreath:'Flame Dragon Breath',goldKitana:'Gold Kitana'};
  const prices={iceBreathDragon:45000,flameDragonBreath:45000,goldKitana:115000};
  if(!names[id])return;
  if(id==='goldKitana'&&currentIsland!=='forest'){showGameMsg('Gold Kitana chỉ bán ở Đảo 2');return;}
  if(!p.ownedSwords[id]){
    if(p.money<prices[id]){showGameMsg('Không đủ '+prices[id].toLocaleString('vi-VN')+' tiền');return;}
    p.money-=prices[id];p.ownedSwords[id]=true;showGameMsg('Đã mua '+names[id]+'!');
  }
  p.equippedWeapon=id;saveProgress(p);updateHUD();swordShopModal.classList.remove('show');
}));
function travelIsland(target){
  if(currentDimension!=='world'){showGameMsg('Không thể đổi đảo trong Hidden Dimension');return;}
  const p=loadProgress();
  if(target==='forest'&&p.level<25){showGameMsg('Cần level 25 để qua Đảo Rừng');return;}
  if(target==='void'&&p.level<40){showGameMsg('Cần level 40 để qua Đảo 3');return;}
  p.island=target;saveProgress(p);currentIsland=target;enemies=[];projectiles=[];effects=[];resetArena();setDimension('world');updateHUD();showGameMsg(target==='void'?'Đã tới Đảo Hắc Tử':(target==='forest'?'Đã tới Đảo Rừng':'Đã về Đảo Khởi Đầu'));
}
document.getElementById('goIsland1').addEventListener('click',()=>travelIsland('starter'));
document.getElementById('goIsland2').addEventListener('click',()=>travelIsland('forest'));
document.getElementById('redeemKeyBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{const p=loadProgress();if(p.keys<=0){showGameMsg('Bạn chưa có Boss Key');return;}showHiddenBossPrompt();});
document.getElementById('fullscreenBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{if(!document.fullscreenElement){await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();fullscreenBtn.textContent='thu nhỏ [F]';}else{await document.exitFullscreen();fullscreenBtn.textContent='phóng to [F]';}}catch(e){showGameMsg('Trình duyệt không hỗ trợ phóng to');}});
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',()=>{fullscreenBtn.textContent=document.fullscreenElement?'thu nhỏ [F]':'phóng to [F]';});
document.getElementById('toggleWeapon').addEventListener('click',toggleWeaponMode);

const boatNpcModal=document.getElementById('boatNpcModal');
const factionNpcModal=document.getElementById('factionNpcModal');
const v2NpcModal=document.getElementById('v2NpcModal');
function openBoatNpc(){ if(currentDimension==='world') boatNpcModal.classList.add('show'); }
function openFactionNpc(){ if(currentDimension==='world') factionNpcModal.classList.add('show'); }
function updateV2QuestText(){const p=loadProgress();const progress=p.v2Quest&&p.v2Quest.accepted?Math.max(0,(p.boss||0)-(p.v2Quest.startBoss||0)):0;v2QuestText.textContent=p.fightingV2?'Võ V2 đã được mở khóa. Damage võ tăng 25%.':(p.v2Quest&&p.v2Quest.accepted?'Tiến độ: '+Math.min(progress,20)+'/20 Boss.':'Nhiệm vụ bí ẩn: hạ 20 boss sau khi nhận nhiệm vụ.');}
function openV2Npc(){if(currentDimension==='world'&&currentIsland==='forest'){updateV2QuestText();v2NpcModal.classList.add('show');}}
document.getElementById('closeBoatNpc').addEventListener('click',()=>boatNpcModal.classList.remove('show'));
document.getElementById('closeFactionNpc').addEventListener('click',()=>factionNpcModal.classList.remove('show'));
document.getElementById('closeV2Npc').addEventListener('click',()=>v2NpcModal.classList.remove('show'));
document.getElementById('acceptV2Quest').addEventListener('click',()=>{const p=loadProgress();if(p.fightingV2){showGameMsg('Bạn đã có Võ V2');return;}if(!p.v2Quest||!p.v2Quest.accepted){p.v2Quest={accepted:true,startBoss:p.boss||0};saveProgress(p);showGameMsg('Đã nhận nhiệm vụ Võ V2: hạ 20 Boss');}updateV2QuestText();});
document.getElementById('claimV2Quest').addEventListener('click',()=>{const p=loadProgress();if(p.fightingV2){showGameMsg('Võ V2 đã mở khóa');return;}if(!p.v2Quest||!p.v2Quest.accepted){showGameMsg('Hãy nhận nhiệm vụ trước');return;}const progress=(p.boss||0)-(p.v2Quest.startBoss||0);if(progress<20){showGameMsg('Chưa đủ: '+Math.max(0,progress)+'/20 Boss');return;}p.fightingV2=true;saveProgress(p);updateHUD();updateV2QuestText();showGameMsg('Đã mở khóa Võ V2! Damage võ +25%');});
document.getElementById('lockedMysterySword').addEventListener('click',()=>showGameMsg('Kiếm ??? sẽ mở khóa sau update'));
document.getElementById('boatGoIsland1').addEventListener('click',()=>{boatNpcModal.classList.remove('show');travelIsland('starter');});
document.getElementById('boatGoIsland2').addEventListener('click',()=>{boatNpcModal.classList.remove('show');travelIsland('forest');});
document.getElementById('boatGoIsland3').addEventListener('click',()=>{boatNpcModal.classList.remove('show');travelIsland('void');});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-change-faction]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const user=localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser');
  const faction=btn.dataset.changeFaction;
  localStorage.setItem('devauth:faction:'+user,faction);
  factionNpcModal.classList.remove('show');
  updateHUD();
  showGameMsg('Đã đổi sang phe '+(faction==='fire'?'Hỏa':faction==='ice'?'Băng':'Phong'));
}));
document.getElementById('lockedLightningChoice').addEventListener('click',()=>showGameMsg('Phe Lôi chưa update nên chưa thể vào'));


mobileM1.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();useM1();});

let joyPointer=null;
function updateJoystick(e){
  const r=joystick.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx=r.left+r.width/2, cy=r.top+r.height/2;
  let dx=e.clientX-cx, dy=e.clientY-cy;
  const max=r.width/2-24;
  const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  if(d>max){dx=dx/d*max;dy=dy/d*max;}
  joystickKnob.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px)`;
  joystickVector.x=dx/max; joystickVector.y=dy/max;
}
joystick.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  joyPointer=e.pointerId; joystick.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); updateJoystick(e);
});
joystick.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.pointerId===joyPointer)updateJoystick(e);});
function stopJoystick(e){
  if(joyPointer!==null && (!e || e.pointerId===joyPointer)){
    joyPointer=null; joystickVector={x:0,y:0}; joystickKnob.style.transform='translate(0,0)';
  }
}
joystick.addEventListener('pointerup',stopJoystick);
joystick.addEventListener('pointercancel',stopJoystick);


canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{
  if(e.button!==0)return;
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),mx=(e.clientX-r.left)*canvas.width/r.width,my=(e.clientY-r.top)*canvas.height/r.height;
  if(currentDimension==='world' && Math.hypot(mx-boatSeller.x,my-boatSeller.y)<42){openBoatNpc();return;}
  if(currentDimension==='world' && Math.hypot(mx-factionChanger.x,my-factionChanger.y)<42){openFactionNpc();return;}
  if(currentDimension==='world' && currentIsland==='forest' && Math.hypot(mx-v2Trainer.x,my-v2Trainer.y)<42){openV2Npc();return;}
  if(currentDimension==='world' && Math.hypot(mx-swordSeller.x,my-swordSeller.y)<42){swordShopModal.classList.add('show');return;}
  useM1();
});
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight',' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;
  if(e.repeat) return;
  if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='z') useZ();
  if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='x') useX();
  if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='c') useC();
  if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='f') document.getElementById('fullscreenBtn').click();
  if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='t') toggleWeaponMode();
  if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='e' && currentDimension==='world'){
    if(Math.hypot(playerObj.x-swordSeller.x,playerObj.y-swordSeller.y)<75) swordShopModal.classList.add('show');
    else if(Math.hypot(playerObj.x-boatSeller.x,playerObj.y-boatSeller.y)<75) openBoatNpc();
    else if(Math.hypot(playerObj.x-factionChanger.x,playerObj.y-factionChanger.y)<75) openFactionNpc();
    else if(currentIsland==='forest' && Math.hypot(playerObj.x-v2Trainer.x,playerObj.y-v2Trainer.y)<75) openV2Npc();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false);


/* Tự vào lại game khi mở link */
window.addEventListener('load',()=>{
  if(typeof L==='undefined'){
    console.warn('Leaflet CDN chưa tải được; phần game Canvas vẫn có thể hoạt động.');
  }
  if(localStorage.getItem('devauth:loggedIn')==='true' && localStorage.getItem('devauth:currentUser')){
    showDeviceScreen();
  }
});

</script>

</body>
</html>
